objective: Discriminate accumulated causal-structure transfer from a shortcut based on positive-outcome frequency, on unseen synthetic parity relations with exactly matched outcome marginals.
scientific_class: isolated development-only sidecar; no real-world or protected-first-use source; no native-learner integration

world_family.public_inputs: context bits c0,c1,c2 and chosen intervention bit a; x=c0+2*c1+4*c2+8*a
world_family.family_0: y = a XOR c_i XOR offset, i in {0,1,2}, offset in {0,1}
world_family.family_1: y = a XOR c_i XOR c_j XOR offset, i<j in {0,1,2}, offset in {0,1}
world_family.outcome_frequency: For each rule exactly 8/16 public input+action queries return y=1; all families and held-out rules have matching 50% outcome marginals.
world_family.true_interventions: Simulator reveals true binary y only after x containing the selected action is issued; learner never receives rule, family, or hidden mask labels.
world_family.heldout: Each of six rules per family is held out from all four training tasks in that case. Candidate hypothesis class is known in advance; this is an unseen instance, not a previously unknown causal family.

cases: 10 seeds x 2 families x 6 held rules = 120 case-folds; deterministic seeds fixed and no resampling after scores
training: Four distinct same-domain rules selected among five nonheld rules per case, five unique intervention x per rule, sampled before observing outcomes; same 20 observations supplied to every arm. No training family labels.
test: At held rule, observe 0,1,2,3,4 selected interventions in sequence. At each stage score 16-input Brier and eight-context action decision regret. Each arm may choose its own interventions but all outcomes are revealed only after selection.
learner: Discrete hierarchical family posterior from four observed training tasks, each marginalized over six equal family hypotheses. Fixed emission noise 0.02 in likelihood for robustness; test readout marginalizes all 12 candidate rules. Predictions and intervention acquisition require only public x,y.
interventions: Active policy chooses unqueried x maximizing p(y=1)*(1-p), ties resolved by ascending x. Random policy chooses seeded uniform unqueried x. Source simulator may compute true outcomes only after x selection.
arms: meta_active: accumulated training-derived family prior + active queries
flat_active: equal family prior + identical active query algorithm
meta_random: learned family prior + random query algorithm
frequency_shadow: Laplace-smoothed public y-by-action counters from the same 20 task examples; receives the identical held task query/outcome sequence of meta_active; no context interactions
conventional_exact_control: independently implemented full 12-hypothesis Bayesian enumerator on identical data, must tie meta_active at every stage
negatives: family-reversed held task at identical seeded experiment settings, report effect
training labels independently shuffled within each training task, frozen deterministic shuffle, report outcomes
exact 50% population marginal verification for every rule
check no held rule occurs in any of four training tasks; no outcome oracle called before selected intervention
checkpoints: Canonical SHA256-pinned JSON sidecar stores precisely training public x/y tasks and posterior; cold restoration rederives posterior and verifies every byte. No source labels in checkpoint.
scores: Mean Brier and mean eight-context policy regret at t=0,1,2,3,4. Report per-family and per-seed results, absolute and relative effects, and paired 95% bootstrap CI with fixed bootstrap seed 19019 and 1000 resamples over 120 case-folds.

success.engineering: Correct frozen scenario counts, marginal equality, SHA-pinned cold state, no hidden-label leakage, exact 12-hypothesis independent Bayes match <=1e-12, anti-tamper and family-flip/shuffle negatives, deterministic repeat, full candidate Linux and Windows regression+atlas checks.
success.development: At t=2 meta_active Brier <=0.85*flat_active Brier, mean regret <=0.80*flat_active regret with flat regret>0, meta_active Brier <=0.85*frequency_shadow Brier. Report failures even if classification NO_GO.
success.action_value: At t=2 mean meta_random regret>0, and meta_active regret<=0.90*meta_random regret. Gate is false if degenerate.
success.scientific: scientific_pass=false irrespective of synthetic outcomes; no superiority over identical Bayesian class, no unprogrammed causal discovery or real-world generality.

authority: Existing CKAD18 qualified PR1207 remains draft; isolated new branch only, no merge/promotion/controller/scheduler changes, no new external runtime or native model mutation. Do not continue primary on a modified protocol.
